verdict.rationale: Yapily is API-first. Its core capabilities are documented as API endpoints: account and transaction retrieval, single, scheduled, periodic and bulk payment initiation, and embedded, pre- and re-authorisation flows. The docs say the API covers payment types the hosted UI does not yet support, so for payments the API is a superset of the hosted UI. Webhook subscriptions are managed through a Webhook API, and an OpenAPI v3 spec is described as the same one Yapily consumes internally. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, no evidence that console/dashboard tasks (application setup, credential management, branding settings) can be done via the API, the OpenAPI file was not found at the standard probed paths, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration.
